authority.division: The worker produces intake files. Only the gate writes db/wks.db. A worker never decides whether its own evidence is good.

goal: Raise the measured quality rubric to 100/100 with documented, reproducible evidence, and keep it there while producing valid, reproducible, evidence-supported findings usable for bug hunting.
goal_is_not: make the gate pass by weakening it

shared_criteria.claim_rule: 100/100 is never claimed unless a SCORES.jsonl row reads total=100.0 AND re-running the scorer reproduces it.

dimensions.intent: Every promoted item rests on 2+ independent publishers, quotes verify live, provenance recorded.
All four domains represented; class maturity >= 90%.
Falsifiable disproofs, no fragments, mechanism-level claims, contradictions surfaced.
Retrieval works, projections do not drift, every round re-runnable from committed artifacts.
Chains with reasons, fp rules per hunting class, weakest classes answer a hunt query.
Gate refuses fabrication; no single-host promotion; duplicates controlled.

open_gaps_as_of_2026_10_04.fix: research + fp rules for the 16 immature classes

open_gaps_as_of_2026_10_04.gap: 83 auto/harvest items carry templated claims under 90 chars
open_gaps_as_of_2026_10_04.fix: rewrite claims as mechanism statements, or re-gate with a claimcheck extension

open_gaps_as_of_2026_10_04.gap: 40 of 54 mature classes have < 2 fp rules
open_gaps_as_of_2026_10_04.fix: the current round targets exactly this

known_gate_gaps.statement: The gate verifies a quote EXISTS on the cited page and that two publishers are independent. It does NOT verify the quote supports the claim's mechanism.
known_gate_gaps.measured: test_gate_refuses_fabrication.py case F2: two verbatim definitional quotes promote a mechanism claim at score ~0.80
known_gate_gaps.impact: the corpus can hold an unsupported-by-quote claim that is still 'verified'
known_gate_gaps.fix_owner: needs a claim/quote entailment component; none exists
known_gate_gaps.do_not: do not delete the F2 case to make the suite green

mechanism: round N: measure rubric -> pick weakest dimension -> dispatch worker with the brief + that dimension's targets
gate every artifact (never --no-verify), record promoted/held/rejected with reasons
re-score the rubric, append to SCORES.jsonl
write feedback/feedback-NN.md: what the worker got wrong, which rejection reasons recur
next round's prompt is built FROM that feedback, not from the same template

iteration_policy.stop_when: rubric total == 100.0 reproduced twice, or no class remains with a measurable gap
never: report a number not re-derived from the db
iteration_policy.budget_per_round: one worker round, one gate pass, one rubric re-score
